criteria.other: Anything else: a different prompt (Chrome extension, Bypass Permissions warning, permission to run a command or edit a file); normal conversation; or the trust prompt only in old scrollback while the session has moved on to a normal input box below it.
criteria.trust_prompt: A heading `Accessing workspace:` followed by a folder path, text like `Quick safety check: Is this a project you created or one you trust?` and `Claude Code'll be able to read, edit, and execute files here.`, then two unnumbered options: `No, exit` first and `Yes, I trust this folder` second, usually followed by `Enter to confirm · Esc to cancel`.
